attBesluta.text: Acheté début septembre 2026, je m'en sert pour tirer des câbles (c'est son but!) dans des gaines annelées de 40 mm. Cette version très longue dispose d'un tire-fil assez fin, mais qui semble quand quand même assez solide, en tous cas, j'ai tiré des câbles ‹REDIGERAT› sur 60 mètres sans problème, après avoir enduit de lubrifiant, quand même! Je recommande ce produit.
Produkt bardzo dobrej jakości. Bez problemu przepchany przez 70 metrową rurkę średnicy około 1,5 cm ( rurka do światłowodu ). Polecam.
I've used Greenlee and IDEAL for years, this is a fish tape and it works the same for a much better price.
My old metal tape bends and jams easily. This fiberglass one stays straight yet flexible for all kinds of curved conduits.
Good cage for the price. My teddy bear hamster is enjoying her multi-story home

Está muy bien, tiene mucho espacio para un hamster, lo mejor es la base de cristal que es muy solida. Llegó muy bien embalada, con muchas protecciones para evitar daños en el envío. La mejor jaula de hamster que he visto, la recomiendo 100X100.

This was purchased for me daughter's ‹NAMN› who really didn't have enough room in his old two decker cage. The little guy has been greatly enjoying the space. He has plenty of space to build things, and still run around. This cage has enabled a previously unrecognized interest in extreme sports: parkour and jumping off platforms, climbing the sides, and dropping down. The cage is sufficiently spacious that my daughter can add extra fill on the bottom.
I used this table for town weeks straight while camping. It's a great product. I am very happy with the purchase.
Haven’t used it yet but didn’t it up. Seems good will Come back once I take it camping.
Nu este grea, dar este foarte stabila, si intuitiv la montare.

Received today, great product overall! The only issue I have is that all six wheels don’t touch the ground simultaneously. At any given time, only four wheels seem to make contact with the ground. I’m not sure if the issue is related to the two larger wheels in the center, which appear to act as a balancing mechanism between the two sides.

I've used a lot of platform carts before, but this one is definitely the best. The weight capacity is amazing, and the build quality is top-notch. I use it every day for construction work, and it has never let me down. Totally worth every penny!
Great cart. Good price. Heavy duty wheels, platform, and sides. Have purchased two. Will probably buy two more when they come back in stock.
Fijne fruitpers, de 1.5 liter is voor mij ruimschoots voldoende. Werkt goed en voldoet aan mijn eisen. Makkelijk schoon te maken en ook weer op te bergen.
